primeras_lineas: This chapter introduces the basic terms and models used to quantify the uncertainty
of both direct and indirect measurements. Basic deﬁnitions such as Type A and Type
B evaluation of uncertainty are introduced, and the GUM approach to the propaga-
tion of uncertainties is explained. Case studies are used to illustrate the approaches to
uncertainty analyses for both types of measurements.
